title: LongScoreStat
description: This mod modifies the statistics and scoreboards of minecraft to use 64bit values instead of 32bit values
body:
This mod modifies the statistics and scoreboards of minecraft to use 64bit values instead of 32bit values.

Currently this mod exist for 2 versions:
- 1.12.2: using ornithe toolchain, this version has both 64bit stats and scoreboards
- 1.17: using fabric toolchain, this version only has the 64bit stats
